blocks.text: used to — «ilgari shunday edi, endi emas»

**used to** + V1 — o'tmishda muntazam bo'lgan, lekin **endi yo'q** odat yoki holat. Asoslari qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 36-dars). O'zbekchada bunga «**-ar edi**», «**-ardi**» va ko'pincha «**ilgari**» so'zi mos keladi: I **used to smoke** — Ilgari **chekardim** (endi chekmayman). used to ning eng muhim xususiyati — u hozir bilan qarama-qarshilikni bildiradi va **faqat o'tmish shakliga** ega: «I use to ...» degan hozirgi zamon yo'q.

rows: **didn't use to** + V1 / **never used to** + V1

items.text: My father **used to work** in a cotton factory.
We **didn't use to** have a car.

blocks.text: used to ikki xil narsani bildiradi. **Takroriy harakat** (odat): I **used to go** swimming every Saturday. **Holat** — be, have, live, like, know, believe, belong kabi fe'llar bilan: This building **used to be** a school; I **used to have** long hair. Ayniqsa **there used to be** («ilgari bu yerda ... bor edi») va **people used to think / believe** («odamlar ilgari ... deb o'ylashardi») iboralari ko'p uchraydi.

items.text: **There used to be** a park here.
People **used to think** that tomatoes were poisonous.
Kate **used to have** a cat called Biscuit.
items.translation: Keytning ilgari Biskvit degan **mushugi bor edi**.

blocks.text: used to va Present Simple: o'tmish va hozir

used to ning hozirgi zamon shakli yo'q. Hozirgi odat haqida Present Simple ishlatiladi, ko'pincha **usually**, **these days**, **now** bilan (→ 2-dars): «I use to get up at six» emas, I **usually get up** at six. used to bilan gapda ko'pincha hozirgi holat ham aytiladi — **but now**, **these days**, **not ... any more**, **no longer**: I **used to** eat a lot of sugar, but **now** I **don't**. Gap oxirida used to yolg'iz kelishi mumkin: I don't play now, but I **used to**.

rows: She **used to** live with her parents.
These days she **has** her own flat.

blocks.text: O'tmishdagi odat uchun Past Simple ham to'g'ri: I **played** football every day = I **used to play** football every day (used to «endi yo'q» ni kuchliroq ta'kidlaydi). Lekin quyidagi holatlarda **faqat Past Simple**: **bir martalik** voqea (I **went** to London in 2019), **necha marta** (I **visited** Khiva three times), **aniq muddat** (I **lived** in Oxford for five years — «used to live for five years» emas). used to — muntazam takrorlanish yoki uzoq holat, aniq hisob emas.

rows: I **used to go** / I **went** there every summer.
I used to go there in 2019.
I used to go there three times.
I used to live there for five years.

items.text: We **used to spend** every summer in the mountains.
We **spent** two weeks in the mountains last July.

blocks.text: **would** ham o'tmishdagi odatni bildiradi, lekin faqat harakat bilan (holat bilan emas): Every evening Grandpa **would tell** us a story (→ 36-dars). **be used to / get used to + -ing** esa butunlay boshqa ma'no — «...ga o'rganib qolgan / o'rganmoq»: I **used to work** at night (ilgari tunda ishlardim) — I**'m used to working** at night (tunda ishlashga o'rganib qolganman). Batafsil → 61-dars.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I use to get up at six» → I **usually** get up at six (hozirgi odat); «I didn't used to» → I **didn't use to**; «Did you used to ...?» → **Did** you **use to** ...?; «I used to live in London for five years» → I **lived** in London for five years; «I used to go to Samarkand three times» → I **went** ... three times; «When I was a child I was going to school by bus» (Past Continuous odat uchun emas) → I **used to go** / I **went** to school by bus.

Eslab qolish: used to = «**ilgari ...ardim, endi esa ...**». Gapga «endi esa boshqacha» qo'shib bo'lsa — used to mos. «Necha marta?», «Qancha vaqt?», «Qachon (bir marta)?» savollariga javob bo'lsa — Past Simple.

rows: didn't use to / never used to
**There used to be** a cinema here.
bir marta, necha marta, aniq muddat
I **played** in a band for two years.

examples.title: Past habits: **used to** + verb
examples.description: O'tmishda muntazam takrorlangan, endi esa yo'q odat: used to + V1. O'zbekchada «-ar edi», «-ardi», ko'pincha «ilgari» so'zi bilan.

sentences.text: Jasur **used to smoke** twenty cigarettes a day, but he gave up last year.
sentences.translation: Jasur ilgari kuniga yigirmata sigaret **chekardi**, lekin o'tgan yili tashladi.

sentences.text: When we lived in Bukhara, we **used to go** to the bazaar every Sunday.
sentences.translation: Buxoroda yashaganimizda har yakshanba bozorga **borardik**.

sentences.text: I **used to walk** to school with my best friend, rain or shine.
sentences.translation: Har qanday ob-havoda eng yaqin do'stim bilan maktabga piyoda **borardim**.

sentences.text: My grandfather **used to tell** us stories about the war every evening.
sentences.translation: Bobom har kecha bizga urush haqida hikoyalar **aytib berardi**.

sentences.text: Kate **used to play** the violin in an orchestra before she became a lawyer.
sentences.translation: Keyt huquqshunos bo'lishidan oldin orkestrda skripka **chalardi**.

sentences.text: On summer evenings, the whole street **used to sit** outside and drink tea.
sentences.translation: Yoz oqshomlarida butun mahalla tashqarida o'tirib choy **ichardi**.

sentences.text: Before the pandemic, Tom **used to travel** abroad for work almost every month.
sentences.translation: Pandemiyadan oldin Tom deyarli har oy ish yuzasidan chet elga **borib turardi**.

sentences.text: We **used to send** each other long letters; now we just send messages.
sentences.translation: Ilgari bir-birimizga uzun xatlar **yozardik**, endi shunchaki xabar yuboramiz.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **used to spend** hours in the library before every exam.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza har imtihondan oldin kutubxonada soatlab **o'tirardi**.

sentences.text: As students, Aziz and Oliver **used to share** a tiny flat in Manchester.
sentences.translation: Talabalik paytida Aziz va Oliver Manchesterda kichkina kvartirada **birga yashashardi**.

examples.title: Past states: **used to be**, **there used to be**
examples.description: used to faqat odat emas, holatni ham bildiradi: be, have, live, like, believe, belong. there used to be — «ilgari bu yerda ... bor edi».

sentences.text: This shopping centre **used to be** a textile factory.
sentences.translation: Bu savdo markazi ilgari to'qimachilik **fabrikasi edi**.

sentences.text: **There used to be** a small cinema on the corner, but it closed years ago.
sentences.translation: Burchakda kichkina **kinoteatr bor edi**, lekin u ko'p yillar oldin yopilgan.

sentences.text: Madina **used to have** very long hair when she was at school.
sentences.translation: Madina maktabda o'qiganida **sochi juda uzun edi**.

sentences.text: I **used to hate** vegetables, but now I love them.
sentences.translation: Ilgari sabzavotlarni **yomon ko'rardim**, endi esa juda yaxshi ko'raman.

sentences.text: Bekzod **used to live** in a village near Fergana before he moved to the capital.
sentences.translation: Bekzod poytaxtga ko'chishidan oldin Farg'ona yaqinidagi qishloqda **yashardi**.

sentences.text: People **used to believe** that the Earth was flat.
sentences.translation: Odamlar ilgari Yerni yassi deb **ishonishardi**.

sentences.text: Our flat **used to belong** to a famous painter, the neighbours say.
sentences.translation: Qo'shnilarning aytishicha, bizning kvartiramiz ilgari mashhur rassomga **tegishli bo'lgan**.

sentences.text: Sarah and I **used to be** close friends, but we lost touch after university.
sentences.translation: Sara ikkalamiz ilgari yaqin **do'st edik**, lekin universitetdan keyin aloqani yo'qotdik.

sentences.text: **There used to be** fields here; now it's all flats and offices.
sentences.translation: Ilgari bu yerda **dalalar bor edi**, endi hammasi uylar va ofislar.

sentences.text: **Did** this street **use to have** trees? I remember it as much greener.
sentences.translation: Bu ko'chada ilgari **daraxtlar bormidi**? Men uni ancha yashilroq eslayman.

examples.title: **didn't use to** ... / **Did** you **use to** ...?
examples.description: Inkor — didn't use to (yoki never used to): «ilgari ...mas edi». So'roq — Did ... use to ...? Diqqat: did dan keyin use (d siz).

sentences.text: **Did** you **use to** play any sport at school? — Yes, I was in the basketball team.
sentences.translation: Maktabda biror sport bilan **shug'ullanarmidingiz**? — Ha, basketbol jamoasida edim.

sentences.text: Emma **didn't use to** like spicy food, but India changed her mind.
sentences.translation: Emma ilgari achchiq ovqatni **yoqtirmasdi**, lekin Hindiston fikrini o'zgartirdi.

sentences.text: Where **did** your family **use to** spend the summer holidays?
sentences.translation: Oilangiz yozgi ta'tilni ilgari qayerda **o'tkazardi**?

sentences.text: We **never used to** lock our door in the village — everyone knew each other.
sentences.translation: Qishloqda eshigimizni hech qachon **qulflamasdik** — hamma bir-birini tanirdi.

sentences.text: **Did** Jasur **use to** work in a bank? — Yes, for a few years, I think.
sentences.translation: Jasur ilgari bankda **ishlarmidi**? — Ha, bir necha yil, shekilli.

sentences.text: This area **didn't use to** be so expensive; ten years ago anyone could rent here.
sentences.translation: Bu hudud ilgari bunchalik **qimmat emasdi**; o'n yil oldin bu yerda har kim ijaraga ola olardi.

sentences.text: How **did** people **use to** keep food cold before fridges were invented?
sentences.translation: Muzlatgich ixtiro qilinishidan oldin odamlar ovqatni qanday qilib sovuq **saqlashardi**?

sentences.text: Nilufar **didn't use to** wear glasses — they're quite new.
sentences.translation: Nilufar ilgari **ko'zoynak taqmasdi** — bular ancha yangi.

sentences.text: **Didn't** you **use to** live next door to the Browns? — Yes, until 2015.
sentences.translation: Ilgari Braunlar bilan **qo'shni emasmidingiz**? — Ha, 2015-yilgacha.

sentences.text: My father **never used to** cook, but since he retired he makes dinner every day.
sentences.translation: Otam ilgari **hech ovqat pishirmasdi**, lekin nafaqaga chiqqanidan beri har kuni kechki ovqat tayyorlaydi.

examples.title: Then and now: **used to** ... but now ...
examples.description: used to faqat o'tmish uchun. Hozirgi odat — Present Simple (usually, these days, now). Bir gapda o'tmish va hozir qarama-qarshi qo'yiladi.

sentences.text: I **used to drink** three coffees a day; these days I only **have** one.
sentences.translation: Ilgari kuniga uchta qahva **ichardim**, hozir esa faqat bittasini **ichaman**.

sentences.text: Tom **used to drive** to work, but now he **cycles** to save money.
sentences.translation: Tom ilgari ishga mashinada **borardi**, endi esa pul tejash uchun **velosipedda boradi**.

sentences.text: These days I **usually go** to bed early, although I **used to stay** up till two.
sentences.translation: Hozir odatda erta **yotaman**, holbuki ilgari soat ikkigacha **o'tirardim**.

sentences.text: My son **used to be** afraid of dogs, but now he **wants** a puppy.
sentences.translation: O'g'lim ilgari itlardan **qo'rqardi**, endi esa kuchukcha **xohlaydi**.

sentences.text: Phones **used to be** big and heavy; now they **fit** in your pocket.
sentences.translation: Telefonlar ilgari katta va og'ir **edi**, endi cho'ntakka **sig'adi**.

sentences.text: Aziz **doesn't eat** meat any more, but he **used to love** shashlik.
sentences.translation: Aziz endi go'sht **yemaydi**, lekin ilgari shashlikni juda **yaxshi ko'rardi**.

sentences.text: Women in the village **used to bake** bread every day; now most people **buy** it.
sentences.translation: Qishloqda ayollar ilgari har kuni non **yopishardi**, endi ko'pchilik uni **sotib oladi**.

sentences.text: Kate **works** from home now, so she **doesn't commute** like she **used to**.
sentences.translation: Keyt endi uydan **ishlaydi**, shuning uchun avvalgidek yo'lda **qatnamaydi**.

sentences.text: We **used to watch** TV together every evening; now everyone **is** on their phone.
sentences.translation: Ilgari har kecha birga televizor **ko'rardik**, endi hamma o'z telefoniga **tikilgan**.

sentences.text: Does James still smoke? — No, he **used to**, but he **stopped** after his son was born.
sentences.translation: Jeyms hali ham chekadimi? — Yo'q, **chekardi**, lekin o'g'li tug'ilgach **tashladi**.

examples.title: **used to** or Past Simple?
examples.description: Odat uchun ikkalasi ham mumkin. Lekin bir martalik voqea, necha marta (three times) va aniq muddat (for five years) — faqat Past Simple.

sentences.text: I **used to visit** my grandparents in Khiva every summer.
sentences.translation: Har yozda Xivadagi bobom va buvimnikiga **borardim**.

sentences.text: I **visited** Khiva three times when I was a student.
sentences.translation: Talabalik paytimda Xivaga uch marta **borganman**.

sentences.text: Madina **lived** in London for five years and then moved to Oxford.
sentences.translation: Madina Londonda besh yil **yashadi**, keyin Oksfordga ko'chdi.

sentences.text: Madina **used to live** in London, but she's in Oxford now.
sentences.translation: Madina ilgari Londonda **yashardi**, hozir esa Oksfordda.

sentences.text: Last year Oliver **ran** a marathon in Edinburgh — the first of his life.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yili Oliver Edinburgda marafon **yugurdi** — umrida birinchi marta.

sentences.text: Oliver **used to run** every morning before his knee injury.
sentences.translation: Tizzasi jarohatlanishidan oldin Oliver har tong **yugurardi**.

sentences.text: We **went** to the mountains twice last summer.
sentences.translation: O'tgan yozda tog'ga ikki marta **bordik**.

sentences.text: We **used to go** to the mountains every weekend when the children were small.
sentences.translation: Bolalar kichikligida har dam olish kunlari toqqa **borardik**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **worked** at the airport for six months after he left school.
sentences.translation: Bekzod maktabni bitirgach olti oy aeroportda **ishladi**.

sentences.text: **Did** your father **use to** take you fishing? — Yes, almost every Saturday.
sentences.translation: Otangiz sizni baliq oviga **olib borarmidi**? — Ha, deyarli har shanba.

examples.title: A changing world: people **used to** ...
examples.description: Jamiyat, texnologiya va tarix: o'tmishdagi holat va odatlar hozirgisi bilan solishtiriladi.

sentences.text: Before smartphones, people **used to carry** paper maps when they travelled.
sentences.translation: Smartfonlardan oldin odamlar sayohatda qog'oz xarita **olib yurishardi**.

sentences.text: Samarkand **used to be** one of the richest cities on the Silk Road.
sentences.translation: Samarqand ilgari Buyuk Ipak yo'lidagi eng boy shaharlardan biri **edi**.

sentences.text: Doctors **used to recommend** smoking for nerves, believe it or not.
sentences.translation: Ishonasizmi-yo'qmi, shifokorlar ilgari asab uchun chekishni **tavsiya qilishardi**.

sentences.text: In the Soviet era, most families **used to wait** years for a car.
sentences.translation: Sovet davrida ko'p oilalar mashina uchun yillab **navbat kutishardi**.

sentences.text: Newspapers **used to make** most of their money from adverts.
sentences.translation: Gazetalar ilgari daromadining katta qismini reklamadan **olardi**.

sentences.text: **Didn't** the Aral Sea **use to** be one of the largest lakes in the world?
sentences.translation: Orol dengizi ilgari dunyodagi eng katta ko'llardan biri **emasmidi**?

sentences.text: Shopping **used to take** a whole afternoon; now it takes five minutes online.
sentences.translation: Xarid qilish ilgari butun yarim kunni **olardi**, endi onlayn besh daqiqa ketadi.

sentences.text: Teachers **used to be** much stricter, my parents always say.
sentences.translation: Ota-onamning doim aytishicha, o'qituvchilar ilgari ancha **qattiqqo'l edi**.

sentences.text: **There used to be** a red phone box on almost every street corner in London.
sentences.translation: Ilgari Londonning deyarli har bir ko'cha burchagida qizil **telefon budkasi bor edi**.

sentences.text: Before the metro was built, it **used to take** two hours to cross the city.
sentences.translation: Metro qurilishidan oldin shaharni kesib o'tish uchun ikki soat **ketardi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: two old classmates remember school
examples.description: Ikki sobiq sinfdosh maktab yillarini eslaydi: used to, didn't use to, Did you use to ...?, there used to be.

sentences.text: — Do you remember Mr Karimov? He **used to give** us so much homework!
sentences.translation: — Janob Karimovni eslaysanmi? U bizga juda ko'p uy vazifasi **berardi**!

sentences.text: — How could I forget? And you **used to copy** mine every morning!
sentences.translation: — Qanday unutay? Sen esa har tong menikidan **ko'chirib olarding**!

sentences.text: — That's not true! Well, maybe sometimes. Where **did** we **use to** sit?
sentences.translation: — Bu yolg'on! Mayli, ba'zan. Biz qayerda **o'tirardik**?

sentences.text: — At the back, next to the window. You **used to** fall asleep there.
sentences.translation: — Orqada, deraza yonida. Sen o'sha yerda **uxlab qolarding**.

sentences.text: — Ha! I **didn't use to** sleep at night because of football on TV.
sentences.translation: — Ha-ha! Televizordagi futbol tufayli kechalari **uxlamasdim**.

sentences.text: — And **did** you **use to** play for the school team as well?
sentences.translation: — Maktab jamoasida ham **o'ynarmiding**?

sentences.text: — Yes, we **used to** train every afternoon, even in winter.
sentences.translation: — Ha, har kuni tushdan keyin, hatto qishda ham **mashq qilardik**.

sentences.text: — **There used to be** a little shop opposite the school, didn't there?
sentences.translation: — Maktab qarshisida kichkina **do'kon bor edi**, to'g'rimi?

sentences.text: — Yes! We **used to** buy samsa there after lessons. It's a bank now.
sentences.translation: — Ha! Darsdan keyin u yerdan somsa **sotib olardik**. Hozir u yerda bank.

sentences.text: — Everything has changed, but I still **miss** those days sometimes.
sentences.translation: — Hamma narsa o'zgardi, lekin ba'zan o'sha kunlarni hali ham **sog'inaman**.

examples.title: Mixed: used to, Past Simple and Present Simple
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: o'tmishdagi odat (used to), bir martalik yoki sanalgan voqea (Past Simple) va hozirgi odat (Present Simple).

sentences.text: When she was younger, Nilufar **used to dream** of becoming a pilot.
sentences.translation: Yoshligida Nilufar uchuvchi bo'lishni **orzu qilardi**.

sentences.text: The factory **employed** three thousand people before it **closed** in 1998.
sentences.translation: Zavod 1998-yilda **yopilishidan** oldin uch ming kishini **ish bilan ta'minlagan**.

sentences.text: My neighbour **used to complain** about our music; now she **comes** to our parties!
sentences.translation: Qo'shnim ilgari musiqamizdan **shikoyat qilardi**, endi esa ziyofatlarimizga **keladi**!

sentences.text: How often **did** you **use to** see your cousins when you lived abroad?
sentences.translation: Chet elda yashaganingizda amakivachchalaringizni qanchalik tez-tez **ko'rib turardingiz**?

sentences.text: Sarah **goes** swimming three times a week, but she **used to** hate water as a child.
sentences.translation: Sara haftada uch marta **suzishga boradi**, bolaligida esa suvni **yomon ko'rardi**.

sentences.text: James **broke** his arm twice in the years when he **used to** do motocross.
sentences.translation: Jeyms motokross bilan **shug'ullanib yurgan** yillarida qo'lini ikki marta **sindirgan**.

sentences.text: Prices **used to** be lower, but salaries **were** lower too.
sentences.translation: Narxlar ilgari pastroq **edi**, lekin maoshlar ham **past edi**.

sentences.text: Didn't you **use to work** with Bekzod? — Yes, we **shared** an office for three years.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bilan **birga ishlarmidingiz**? — Ha, uch yil bitta ofisda **o'tirganmiz**.

sentences.text: Tashkent **used to have** trams in the centre, but they **were removed** in 2016.
sentences.translation: Toshkent markazida ilgari **tramvaylar bor edi**, lekin ular 2016-yilda **olib tashlangan**.

sentences.text: I **used to think** that learning English was impossible, but now I **read** novels in it.
sentences.translation: Ilgari ingliz tilini o'rganish imkonsiz deb **o'ylardim**, endi esa unda romanlar **o'qiyman**.
